programmes.eligibility: TNMGRMU: pass in 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology (or equivalent, 12 years of schooling) with at least 35% in each subject including English; age 17 by 31 December of the admission year; candidates from boards other than the TN Higher Secondary need a TNMGRMU eligibility certificate. Institute page: HSC with PCB+Maths or PC+Botany+Zoology.
programmes.internshipPostings: Cath lab and blood bank, echo room, ICCU, Holter (3 months each)

programmes.officialTitle: B.Sc Operation Theatre and Anaesthesia Technology
programmes.eligibility: As for B.Sc Cardiac Technology (TNMGRMU AHS regulations).
programmes.internshipPostings: Sterilisation room 3 months, post-operative/recovery 3 months, surgical ICU 3 months, operation theatres 3 months (general surgery, O&G, paediatrics, others)

admissionRoute: Direct institutional admission via https://riahs.rmi.net.in/online-application. B.Sc Cardiac Technology and OTAT are not offered under TN DME government quota in self-financing colleges (2025-26 paramedical prospectus), so the state government-quota rules (Indian citizenship, TN nativity) do not apply to these seats.
